name: Nelson Waldorf School

geo.address: 3648 Silverking Ski Hill Road, Nelson, BC V1L 6N2
geo.coord_source: BC Ministry school-location dataset 2025/2026 (DataBC geocode of the registered address)

description: Independent Waldorf school on the edge of Nelson in the West Kootenay mountains; Kindergarten to Grade 9 with an early-years centre. Group 1 independent school and Associate member of AWSNA since 1984. Among the lowest Waldorf tuitions in Canada.

attributes.philosophy: Waldorf 'head, heart and hands' pedagogy: storytelling, main-lesson books, handwork, natural art materials; early years play-based.

legal_status.label: Independent school, Group 1 (Independent School Act, B.C.)
legal_status.authority: B.C. Ministry of Education and Child Care — Independent Schools Branch

attributes.curriculum: Waldorf curriculum within B.C. program requirements.

tuition.notes: K–Grade 9 full tuition $6,240 (12 × $520); tuition modification for combined family net income under $120,000; sibling discounts 10% / 35%. International students $1,684 per month (2025/26 rate).

attributes.additional_fees: Registration $250/yr, supply fee $300, society membership $30/family, one-time enrolment fee $300 for new students; bus $55/student/month.
attributes.admission: Steps to enrolment published on the school site; mid-year admission prorated.
attributes.transportation: School bus service, $55 per student per month (2026-27).

campuses.name: Main campus
campuses.address: 3648 Silverking Ski Hill Rd, Nelson, BC V1L 6N2

advantages: Very low tuition for a Waldorf school (ministry funding covers much of the budget)
limitations: Small-town location far from a major airport
attributes.qualifying_reason: Private Group 1 independent school with a Waldorf programme to Grade 9; tuition 2026-27, accreditation and register confirmed 2026-10-30.
